entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R. Case No.1251 of 2022 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M.,
Dhenkanal, arising out of Dhenkanal Town P.S. Case No.526 of 2022 for commission of the offence under Sections 419/420/120-B/468/471/34 IPC.
3.
Being aggrieved by the rejection of her application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Dhenkanal, by order dated 17.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the allegation against the present Petitioner is that she impersonated herself as one Susamarani Panda and in connivance with the co-accused duped the Informant for a sum of Rs.8 lakhs for purchasing a land for the said Susamarani Panda.
5. It is further submitted that even if the entire allegation of the prosecution is accepted at its face value, in the entire transaction she has been paid a sum of Rs.1 lakh to the Petitioner.
Hence, she may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits that all the accused persons in the active connivance have duped the Informant.
Hence, the Petitioner ought not to be released on bail merely because the investigation is completed.

sentences.text: 1 7. Considering the nature of allegation and that the Petitioner is a lady and is in custody since 26.09.2022, this Court keeping in view the first proviso to Section 437(1) Cr.P.C., directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin subject to verification of the criminal antecedent of similar nature.
8. If the Petitioner has any such antecedent, this order shall stand recalled.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
